ground_truth.cause: flagd-config sets paymentStrictTokenCheck defaultVariant to 100%. Payment routes charge requests through strict card-token validation and rejects the synthetic tokens with card token rejected by processor.
ground_truth.impact: Payment charge requests fail and checkout reports downstream failure. This does not establish an external provider outage or broken cart, catalog, or Redis.
ground_truth.mitigation: Restore paymentStrictTokenCheck to off in flagd-config and verify charge and checkout requests recover. Do not rotate real provider credentials based only on the synthetic rejection message.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
